transactions.counterparty: Daiwa House Industry Co., Ltd. (Sponsor; interested party)
transactions.citation: p49: purchase consideration JPY 2,640.0m, an 18.1% discount to the average of two independent valuations of JPY 3,225.0m as at 31 Aug 2023; freehold logistics property in Ibaraki, wholly leased to Mitsubishi Shokuhin; acquired from Sponsor (interested-party transaction)
transactions.notes: Acquisition, so the five divestment fields are not applicable and left null; the 18.1%-below-valuation discount is an ACQUISITION-side favourable pricing metric (not a gain_loss_pct on a sale) and is preserved here in notes only, not stored in the divestment fields, per spec (gain_loss_pct is scoped to divestments). Valuation as at 31 Dec 2024 grew to JPY 3,350m (p50), i.e. 26.9% above the purchase consideration — a subsequent revaluation, not a transaction outcome.

transactions.counterparty: DH Asia Investment Peony Pte. Ltd. (wholly-owned Sponsor subsidiary; interested party)
transactions.citation: p49: agreed property value VND 483.0 billion, 3.0% below the average of two independent valuations of VND 498.0 billion (as at 30 Sep and 30 Nov 2023); DHLT's first property outside Japan, a BTS cold-storage facility in Long An province near Ho Chi Minh City, leased to Meito Vietnam on a 20-year lease from Oct 2023; acquired via purchase of 100% of the capital of DH Logistics Management Vietnam Co., Ltd. from a Sponsor subsidiary
transactions.notes: Acquisition (100% equity purchase of the SPV holding the property), so the five divestment fields are not applicable and left null. The 3.0%-below-valuation discount is an ACQUISITION-side pricing metric, preserved in notes only. Valuation as at 31 Dec 2024 grew to VND 512.7bn (p50), 6.1% above the purchase consideration — a subsequent revaluation, not a transaction outcome.
